recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR-core source work is recommended for FHIR-24571 unless the work group later decides to replace role-oriented server/client terminology more broadly as a separate policy change.
issue_request: FHIR-24571 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked the Clinical Safety page to replace ambiguous uses of "server" with "endpoint" where appropriate; the accepted resolution instead clarified that server means "HTTP server" because that term was more recognizable than "HTTP endpoint".
initial_application: Commit 9ae342407271a74f8be031342cf385669c2a8a4e applied the issue to source/safety.html by changing the search-safety introduction to "client and HTTP server" and the search-parameter checklist item to "HTTP server's CapabilityStatement".
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes safety.html in the build, and source/fhir.ini actively includes codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml as the safety-entries CodeSystem linked from the safety page. Later FHIR-34155 reconciliation refined the same search-param-names item and added the matching active CodeSystem concept while preserving the "HTTP server" clarification. Remaining server wording on the safety page is role-oriented checklist language, not the ambiguous client/server search phrase targeted by this issue.
reconciliation: Made no source change. The current build-scope safety narrative and formal checklist CodeSystem already carry the intended "HTTP server" clarification where it affects implementer understanding.
